The Caterham Motorsport 2027 calendar is officially here, promising another year of thrilling races across all championships. For next year, we have decided to bring our championships together at almost every round.

2027 sees our Academy Championship return to the fabled Curborough Sprint Course on the 2 and 3 of April, following their pre-season introduction to motorsport program, including the Academy seminar, ARDS day, and exclusive track day at Lydden Hill.

In an exciting update for the new season, the previous Roadsport Championship has now been officially rebranded as the Clubsport Championship, as the Caterham Motorsport Horse HR13 engine takes its next step up the championship ladder.

Our first race weekend with all championships takes place on 24 and 25 April at Snetterton, shortly after our official Media Day. From there, the paddock will travel together to some of the UK’s most spectacular circuits, tackling the coastal twists of Anglesey in May, the challenging Croft circuit in June, and the iconic Brands Hatch in July.

A standout highlight of the 2027 season is the much-anticipated international away round. While our Academy drivers take a mid-summer break, our Clubsport, Seven 270R, Seven 310R, and Seven Championship UK grids will cross the channel to the Netherlands on 24 and 25 July, taking on the legendary banking of Zandvoort.

Included as part of iRacing’s recently announced ‘Season 4’ upgrade, the Caterham Academy and the 420R race cars allow fans of the sim-racing platform the chance to experience the brand's iconic lightweight sports car in the virtual world for the first time.

Established in 2003, iRacing is the world’s leading online racing platform. Featuring over 180 officially licensed cars and more than 150 race circuits, it is currently enjoyed by more than 350,000 sim racers and gamers around the globe.

Offering intoxicating performance, the track-only 420R race car features a naturally aspirated 2.0-litre Ford Duratec motorsport-tuned engine producing 180bhp, mated to a six-speed SADEV sequential gearbox and Nova Motorsport slick tyres, delivering exceptional levels of grip and driver engagement. Prices for the Seven 420R race car start at £53,990 in the UK or €59,995 in Europe.

All 12 vehicles are finished in a bespoke Aqua paint and Miami Special Edition decal pack in Vibrant Pink and White. To finish the exterior design, the use of the official Miami script and silhouette of the Miami International Autodrome circuit features on the rear of the car.
The bespoke aesthetics continue throughout the interior with the Miami script embroidered on the headrests, and an individually numbered plaque located on the dashboard.

With two of our Miami Special Edition Sevens being offered at the Bonhams auction, and our team attending events throughout the week including Monterey British, we will have a valuable opportunity to showcase the brand and meet both existing and new contacts.

“Our attendance is deliberately focused on being present, building relationships and exploring opportunities with prospective dealers, partners and those involved in the motorsport community. As we continue to develop Caterham’s presence in the US, Monterey provides the ideal setting to introduce more people to the brand and strengthen the connections that will support our future growth.”

Caterham Cars Announce Strategic Partnership with Würth UK to Enhance Manufacturing Operations

Caterham Cars is pleased to announce a new strategic partnership with Würth UK, one of the UK's leading suppliers of assembly tools, fastening technology and workshop solutions. The collaboration marks an important step in further enhancing the efficiency, precision and quality of Caterham's manufacturing operations at its Dartford facility.

The partnership was formally signed at the prestigious ADAC 24-Hour Race at the Nürburgring, one of motorsport's most iconic events. To mark the occasion, Würth UK hosted a brand activation within the Caterham Nürburgring showroom, while Würth UK Managing Director, Omar Edris, joined the pre-race parade on the world-famous Nordschleife in Caterham's recently launched Seven 340 Nürburgring Edition.

Caterham and Motul renew their partnership focused on performance

Caterham and Motul today announce the renewal of their partnership, bringing together Caterham’s lightweight sports car expertise and Motul’s long-standing know-how in high-performance lubrication, built on more than 170 years of experience.

The new long-term agreement means that every new Caterham Seven built at the Caterham HQ in Dartford, UK will have their first fill of lubricants supplied by Motul – from the road-going 170 to every new race car across all five Caterham Motorsport UK Championships.
As part of the partnership, Motul will also become the title sponsor of the Caterham Seven Championship UK for the 2026 season, the nationally recognised top-tier Caterham racing series in the UK.

Ali McColl, Global Head of Marketing, Caterham, commented: “This partnership is a significant milestone for Caterham, aligning our brand with a world-renowned leader in lubricants and fluid technology, reinforcing our commitment to performance across both our road and race cars. Motul brings a depth of experience in performance and efficiency that few other partners can offer.”

“This agreement also marks an exciting new chapter for Caterham Motorsport. As we look ahead to the 2026 season, we are proud to unveil the Motul Caterham Seven Championship UK as the new name for the pinnacle of Caterham racing in the UK.”

Caterham and Motul successfully launched their new partnership at the 2026 edition of Rétromobile in Paris, showcasing two Caterham Sevens, a 2005 K-Series and a 2025 Super Seven 2000, for visitors of the show to see on the Motul stand.
